calendar.defaultSubtext: Tap a date to log symptoms

step1.title: 1. Navigate & Select
step1.body: Use the arrows at the top of the calendar to switch months. Tap any date to select it, and the tracker cards below instantly update to show your logs for that day.

step2.title: 2. Log Your Period
step2.bodySuffix: button. The calendar will highlight in pink. Tap days to toggle bleeding on or off. Tap Done to save your cycle dates.

step3.title: 3. Log Daily Rhythm
step3.body: Scroll down to see dynamic cards for symptoms, moods, water intake, and more. Each card is tailored to your current phase. Changes are saved automatically as you tap.

fertility.title: Fertility
fertility.bbtHint: Take it on waking, before getting out of bed.
fertility.opkHint: A peak means your surge was detected. Ovulation usually follows within a day.
fertility.suggestionBody: Cycle-length math is a rougher estimate for irregular or PCOS cycles. A daily temperature or ovulation test (or a synced wearable) gives a clearer signal, so we've turned this section on for you.

discharge.title: Cervical Discharge
discharge.subtitle: Answer 3 questions for accurate phase prediction
discharge.infoText: This questionnaire (MPIQ) helps track your cycle phase by analyzing your body's biological markers.

q1.heading: 1. Vaginal Fluid
q1.description: On touch and feel, what is the consistency of the discharge?

q2.heading: 2. How does it look?
q2.description: Observe the color and clarity of your cervical fluid.

q3.heading: 3. Vaginal Sensation
q3.description: How does it feel down there throughout the day?

logFirstPeriodHint: Log your first period to unlock phase tracking and fertile window predictions.

headline.lateAdviceLong: A week or more is worth looking into. If pregnancy is possible, a test will tell you more. Otherwise, consider checking in with a doctor.
headline.lateAdviceShort: A few days either way is common. Stress, illness, travel and poor sleep can all shift a cycle.
headline.staleAnchorAdvice: We've lost track of your cycle. Log the first day of your last period to start your predictions again.

toasts.periodSaveFailed: Failed to save some period dates
toasts.entrySavedDescription: Your daily log has been updated.

sections.exerciseInfo: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity daily for better cycle regularity and hormonal health.
sections.hydrationInfo: Drink at least 2L of water (8 glasses) daily to stay hydrated, support detoxification, and maintain healthy cognitive function.
sections.sleepInfo: 7-9 hours of quality sleep is recommended for optimal hormonal balance, mood regulation, and physical recovery.
